criteria.statement: Sessions survive a process restart (kept in a SQLite file at options.path)

check.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { createSessionStore } from "./src/sessions.js"; const path = process.env.TECERA_RESOURCE_DB; const a = createSessionStore({ path }); a.set("s1", { user: "ada" }); a.close(); const b = createSessionStore({ path }); assert.deepEqual(b.get("s1"), { user: "ada" }); b.close();'

criteria.statement: A deleted session stays deleted after a restart

check.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { createSessionStore } from "./src/sessions.js"; const path = process.env.TECERA_RESOURCE_DB; const a = createSessionStore({ path }); a.set("s1", { user: "ada" }); a.set("s2", { user: "bob" }); a.delete("s1"); a.close(); const b = createSessionStore({ path }); assert.equal(b.get("s1"), undefined); assert.deepEqual(b.get("s2"), { user: "bob" }); b.close();'

criteria.statement: The store keeps its API and its own tests pass
